problem_statement: The 11ty eleventy-base-blog starter is a runnable Eleventy v3 blog: a base layout, a home layout, a post layout, a reusable postslist partial, four Markdown posts, site metadata, and bundled CSS with a light/dark theme. It has already been restyled into a credible independent editorial persona, "The Marginalia Review" — a small review about the craft of reading, edited by Odile Fenwick (paper background, ink-red accent, serif display headings), with the archive renamed "The Shelf". Your job is to finish the review's reader-facing browse experience: add and correctly wire the Shelf topic filter. Directly above the shared postslist (on the Home "Latest from the Review" list, the Shelf archive, and the About page), render a "Browse the shelf" control — a pill row of columns (All columns, Reading notes, Marginalia, Typography) plus a live count readout with the exact format "Showing N of M · <Column>". Clicking a column must filter the essay cards by their topic tag and update the readout to the live count and chosen column; clicking Typography on the Home list must show the Typography essays and read "Showing 1 of 3 · Typography". The filter is a shared component that must appear on the Home, Shelf, and About surfaces, its pill row must wrap without horizontal overflow at 390px, and its card grid must stay legible (no overlapping or near-invisible cards). Keep every Eleventy source boundary and the existing architecture — the metadata, layouts, partials, posts, and dark-mode CSS variables. Do not introduce a frontend framework, a client-side router, or an unrelated build system, and do not edit the generated _site output as the source of truth.
required_content: Render a shared "Browse the shelf" topic filter (class shelf-filter) directly above the shared postslist on the Home, Shelf, and About surfaces, using the existing Eleventy Nunjucks partial/include model.

The filter must expose a pill row of columns — All columns, Reading notes, Marginalia, Typography — and a live count readout (class shelf-filter__readout) whose text follows the exact format "Showing N of M · <Column>".

Clicking a column pill must filter the shared essay cards by their topic tag and update the readout to the live count and chosen column; on the Home list, clicking Typography must show the Typography essays and read exactly "Showing 1 of 3 · Typography".
The Shelf topic filter must be present on all three surfaces (Home, Shelf, About); a filter that appears on the Home page only, or on Home and Shelf but not About, is incomplete.
The filter pill row must wrap cleanly with no horizontal overflow at 390px, and the filtered card grid must remain legible — no overlapping/shingled cards and no near-invisible low-contrast text.

Preserve the restyled editorial persona: the wordmark The Marginalia Review, editor Odile Fenwick, the archive labelled The Shelf, the four rewritten reading-life essays, and the About copy describing an independent publication about the craft of reading.

Preserve the original Eleventy shell across pages: the Home/About navigation, header wordmark, atom feed link, the post layout with its date/tag metadata and syntax highlighting, the local possum image on the fourth post, and the Built with Eleventy footer credit.
Do not leave any starter residue: the strings Eleventy Base Blog v9, This is my first post, I am a person that writes stuff, and the agile-frameworks filler must not appear anywhere in the site.
Desktop (1440), tablet (834) and mobile (390) states must have no horizontal overflow.
design_constraints: Use the repo's existing Eleventy v3 architecture, Nunjucks layouts/partials, and inlined-CSS bundle model; do not introduce a frontend framework, client-side router, or unrelated build system.

The Shelf topic filter is the review's own browse control: place it directly above the shared postslist, style it with the existing paper surface + ink-red accent, and keep the pill row fluid so it wraps rather than overflows on small viewports.
Keep the filter's count readout truthful: it must recompute the visible-card count live on each column click (Showing N of M · Column), never a snapshot frozen at load.
Preserve the existing CSS custom properties and the prefers-color-scheme dark-mode block; only add or re-tune variables where they support the editorial palette and the filter.

Keep the post list reusable through _includes/postslist.njk so the Home list and the Shelf archive inherit the same card implementation, and carry each post's topic tags onto its card so the filter can match.
state_constraints: desktop_home verifies the restyled Marginalia Review hero, the Latest from the Review heading, the Browse the shelf topic filter above the shared card list, the original Home/About navigation, and the Built with Eleventy footer credit.
mobile_home verifies the restyled home layout and the Shelf filter pill row stack cleanly at 390px without horizontal overflow.
tablet_home verifies the restyled home layout at an intermediate 834px viewport.
desktop_journal verifies the Shelf archive inherits the shared postslist partial, lists the rewritten essays, and carries the Browse the shelf topic filter.
mobile_journal verifies the archive cards, filter, and navigation remain usable at 390px.
desktop_about verifies the rewritten About page describing The Marginalia Review and its editor, and that the Browse the shelf topic filter is present on the About surface too.
desktop_post verifies the fourth post page retains the post layout, tags, and its local possum image after the restyle.
desktop_post_color verifies the typography post retains its long heading, fenced code, and Prism syntax highlighting.
desktop_home_filter verifies that clicking the Typography column on the Home Shelf filter filters the cards and updates the readout live to "Showing 1 of 3 · Typography".

change_completion: The Browse the shelf topic filter is rendered above the shared postslist on the Home, Shelf, and About surfaces with an All/Reading notes/Marginalia/Typography pill row and a live Showing N of M count readout.
Clicking a column filters the essay cards and updates the readout live; clicking Typography on the Home list reads Showing 1 of 3 · Typography.
design_consistency: The filter uses the editorial paper + ink-red palette and stays compatible with the existing Eleventy CSS-variable / dark-mode system, wrapping its pill row rather than overflowing.
The restyle and the filter are implemented in Eleventy source (partial, CSS, JS, postslist) rather than in generated _site output.
regression: The Home/About navigation, header wordmark, atom feed, post layout, tags, syntax highlighting, and Eleventy build credit remain intact across pages.
Build and static serving continue to pass through the Eleventy workflow with no console or network errors.
responsive: Desktop, tablet, and 390px mobile captures have no horizontal overflow, including the Shelf filter pill row.
Hero, filter pills, cards, navigation, and long post titles wrap cleanly and stay legible.

scoring_notes: A correct patch keeps the full editorial restyle and adds a correctly wired Shelf topic filter: present on Home, Shelf and About, with a live count readout that recomputes on each column click (Showing 1 of 3 · Typography on the Home list). Shipping the filter on the Home page only, or on Home and Shelf but not About, should fail the cross-page dom_assertions. A pill row that overflows 390px should fail no_horizontal_overflow. Overlapping/shingled cards or near-invisible low-contrast text should fail visual_regression. A readout snapshotted at load so the count stays frozen after a click should fail interaction_assertions. Editing only _site, or removing navigation/feed/post pages/syntax highlighting, should fail completion, forbidden, regression, or responsive checks.
